summary: Verified the onboarding 'Next' button bug fix on the react-native-web PassMate app. All acceptance criteria pass: Next advances slide 1 -> 2 -> 3 with title AND active dot indicator in sync, button label switches to 'Get Started' on slide 3, Get Started navigates to Home tab (PassMate header + Quick Actions + Start Adaptive Practice visible). Newly added dot-tap navigation works (tapping dot 3 from slide 1 jumps to slide 3). Skip works from slide 1, lands on Home, and persists after reload (onboarding not shown again).
critical_code_review_comments: src/app/onboarding.tsx is clean: state-driven rendering (no FlatList/scroll refs) eliminates the onMomentumScrollEnd desync on web. Has all required testIDs. No issues found.
seed_data_creation: None. Cleared localStorage between test runs to reset onboarding-seen state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Onboarding screen (src/app/onboarding.tsx) now uses simple useState indexing instead of FlatList scrollToOffset. Public URL: https://a84d9224-c5f7-4586-b07f-c6eb61db1d55.preview.emergentagent.com. To force onboarding: clear localStorage then reload. testIDs available: onboarding-screen, onboarding-slide, onboarding-next-button, onboarding-skip-button, onboarding-dot-0/1/2.
rca of the issue: Original bug: FlatList paging on react-native-web called scrollToOffset({animated:true}) but onMomentumScrollEnd fires unreliably (or with mismatched contentOffset) for programmatic scrolls on web, so setCurrentIndex was never triggered after clicking Next, giving the appearance the button did nothing. Fix (verified): removed FlatList entirely and render only SLIDES[currentIndex]; Next handler is a pure setCurrentIndex(i => i+1). Verified via Playwright on the live preview URL — all 3 slides transition, dots update, Get Started label appears on slide 3, navigation to /(tabs) succeeds, Skip + persistence work.
